claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Gatifloxacin is a fluoroquinolone antibacterial with no meaningful activity against human cancer cells at 2.5 uM; its only human-relevant off-target (HERG block, IC50 ~130 uM) is far above the test concentration, so it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
